quote_original: That is why I urge everyone to live nobly.
context_before: In this wonderful world we have created nightmares which we cannot endure forever, so they will have to be uncreated.
context_after: Sow your mind with ideas worthy of recall, because the day is coming when that which is built on any foundation other than Christ will be consumed or uncreated. You will survive, but only as through fire.
selection_note: Verbatim lecture excerpt from Four Fold Vision (1968-01-26).

author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: Delivered in public spoken lecture on 1968-01-26 in the United States; public domain under 1909 US Copyright Act.
quote_original: Blake saw everything as an image.
context_before: Start with one image and it will become two, then four, then eight as everything will form an image in your mind.
context_after: To the world Scofield was a lonely soldier asleep in a garden. But, because Blake’s garden was the image of his creativity, finding a sleeping, drunken soldier there was like finding him in his wife’s bed, so Blake removed him. Although a very small man in stature, Blake had the courage of a giant, and removed that which was the symbol of his spiritual enemy.
selection_note: Verbatim lecture excerpt from Four Fold Vision (1968-01-26).
